newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to sell 500,000 NTT shares by end 1997 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan to sell 500,000 NTT shares by end 1997 - paper.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans to sell 500,000 shares of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) by the end of this year, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said it would be the first sale of NTT shares by the ministry in about nine years.
The ministry was not immediately available for comment.
MOF sold 5.4 million NTT shares in the three years to March 1989 following the firm's privatisation in 1985, but it has not sold any since then due to weakness in the stock market, the paper said.
The ministry currently owns 10.43 million shares, or 65.5 percent of NTT's outstanding stock.
